summary: Bilingual release notes help you discover what changed and browse earlier releases.

items.text: Release notes appear when you first enter the workspace after an upgrade. Dismissing them prevents repeated prompts for that version.
View release history from Settings and return to the current release at any time.
Release notes use the standard dialog design, with all content expanded and scrolling for longer updates.
Read release notes in Simplified Chinese or English, following your interface language.
